FunctionInput_zigpoll_updateslide.description: Identify a slide and supply only the authoring changes to apply.

id.description: Identifier of the updated slide; identity is retained.

title.description: Resulting title after provider processing; validation of title removal is provisional.

handle.description: Resulting provider-generated slide handle, when returned.

pollId.description: Identifier of the poll containing this slide.

content.description: Resulting structured authoring fields, including answers, rows, settings, rules, and other content, keyed by original Zigpoll names; excludes identity, timestamps, and counters.

updatedAt.description: lastModified normalized to UTC Z without precision loss, preserving null when returned.

FunctionOutput_zigpoll_updateslide.description: The updated slide identity and confirmed authoring values returned by Zigpoll.

tags.instructions: Get the slide ID from `list-slides` or `get-slide`. Supply only changes. settings is a patch: this tool preserves other current settings for you, whereas arrays such as answers and rows replace their entire collection. Null removes an explicitly nullable authoring field; an empty string or array remains an empty value. settings.hidden:true hides the question without deleting it; false shows it. Concurrent edits may race. Use `create-slide` for a new question.
